subject_review.clause: Macy's Substack post criticizes opponent Ben Cline for voting against the John Lewis Voting Rights Advancement Act, describing this as a vote against protecting 'minority access to the ballot.' Her post also cites the SAVE Act as making 'it harder for women to vote' by creating new barriers.
